## Introduction

This site collects the core models, estimators and identification strategies from the M.Sc. Economics in one place.
It is a resource to quickly recall past learnings but is in no way exhaustive. You will, for example, find only 
very basic Game Theory as I chose to specialize in Public Economics (PE) and Growth & Trade (GT).

## Using the R examples

All examples are written in R and can be run as-is. Packages are loaded at the top of each example. Install any that are missing with `install.packages("<name>")`. Examples use simulated or built-in data so the output can be reproduced exactly.

## About the author

Christian Gessinger completed a B.Sc. in Economics at the University of Bonn (10/2021 – 03/2025) and is pursuing an M.Sc. in Economics in Barcelona (09/2025 – 09/2027).

::: {.callout-note}
## Sources
Content is based on the lecture slides, textbooks and notes from the programme. Where a page follows a specific textbook, the reference is given at the end of that page.
:::
